title: Workforce applicant intake
lede: Factual applicant logging, direct material links, and a faster review control. These changes have not been deployed.

sections.heading: Rendered evidence pending
sections.note: No matched captures are available: this merged branch has no managed preview. Production currently runs the prior interface. No before/after images or visual acceptance are claimed.

changes.was: Applicant cards did not surface recognized source document links or logged experience summaries.
changes.now: Cards and detail views expose recognized HTTPS document links; cards show the logged experience summary.

changes.was: Marking Reviewed required opening applicant details.
changes.now: A dedicated Reviewed control saves from the board and guards repeated submissions.

changes.was: Cycle and application loading errors offered no direct retry.
changes.now: Separate failure states offer retry and ignore superseded responses.
